concepts.title: 简洁列表
concepts.direction: COMPOSITION A: an understated flat list, no cards. Container x~128 width1120. At y76 put compact 搜索插件 input width280 aligned RIGHT. Four thin-divider rows beginning y136, row height88. Each row 36px colored-outline icon at x144 centered vertically, title and subtitle stacked with4px gap at x196; far right single button 使用 for first or plain muted 待接入 for pending rows. Only hairline separators, no table headers, no enclosing border, no section labels, no colored row slabs. Book entry first. Consistent icon/text/action columns, utility-first comparison. The rows must be much shorter than original cards. Status and action remain aligned at far right. Precise breathing space around single-line text.
concepts.prompt:
Use case UI-mockup. Create ONE complete desktop PLUGIN CATALOG workspace screen, full viewport 1375x870 landscape; all edges visible, no device mockup or browser chrome. The attached screenshot is the current PLUGIN CONTENT PANE ONLY, with sidebar outside the crop: do NOT add a sidebar or brand header. Preserve the compact existing top bar with outlined puzzle icon and 插件 at left, 重新连接 and connection icon at right, height52px, thin divider. Redesign the catalog below. This is a utility workbench NOT a marketing landing page: no giant headings, no hero, no photos, no illustrations, no decorative 3D assets, no stock art. Calm professional and carefully aligned.
STRICT SHARED WEBSITE SYSTEM: white background#fff, cool light surface#f5f6f9, ink#202735, secondary#667183, border#e8ebf0, blue accent#3864e8 and soft active#edf2ff. Chinese Segoe UI/Microsoft YaHei-like sans-serif, body14px, controls13px, caption12px, plugin title16px semibold. Controls height36px, corners8px; cards if used12px radius and16px padding; spacing4/8/12/16/20/24; page inset20px, content max width1120px centered. No viewport-scaling typography, no massive padding, no dark mode, no colored large backgrounds, no gradients or blurry glass, no bright rainbow icons.
EXACT FOUR REAL ITEMS ONLY, with consistent36px square pastel outline icon book / video / globe / landscape:
官网知识 — 检索道引产品与方案的公开资料 — AVAILABLE with single action button 使用. 
短剧制作 — 从剧本到视频成片 — NOT CONNECTED.
网站与应用 — 对话创建网站与轻应用 — NOT CONNECTED.
文旅影像 — 生成景区场景人像 — NOT CONNECTED.
Availability MUST remain clear: company knowledge is the ONLY executable entry. Other three must carry noninteractive 待接入 status either once per item OR once as clear shared group heading. Do not add install buttons, switches, favorites, stars, ratings, downloads, prices, launch controls for pending entries, fake counts or extra plugins. 使用 acts via existing session selection flow, not external installation.
COPY BUDGET: ONLY four plugin names, four short one-line descriptions above, three pending markers or one grouped pending heading, one 使用 button, one 搜索插件 field with magnifying glass, preserved topbar. Absolutely NO capability chips or tag clouds. NO duplicate instructions such as 选择可用插件，在会话中使用, 访客空间可用, 已有...能力, 尚未接入此工作台, 暂不可选, 返回会话使用. No repeated page title in content. Public-only scope is already conveyed by 公开资料 in company description. No explanatory footers. Good normal-text contrast. Draw authentic buildable DOM-level interface design with precise alignment and spare composition. Entire content in upper half; let empty remainder remain calm instead of adding filler.

concepts.title: 可用优先
concepts.direction: COMPOSITION B: availability-based layout without redundant status pills. Search field width260 at top right y76. At y130 a compact section label 可用, font12, count omitted. Below y156 a single modest horizontal available module height92 spanning1120, very light #f8faff and1px pale blue border12px radius. Book icon36px at left, 官网知识 title16 and public-source subtitle14 stacked, blue 使用 button36px at right. This is a useful compact row, NOT a hero. Then y284 shared label 待接入 font12. Below y310 THREE compact borderless modules in one row, equal columns with very faint vertical hairline between: icon36 at left with name16 and short description14 stacked to right. The group heading 待接入 clearly applies to all three; do NOT repeat pending badges in each module. Use main area as a clear distinction between the one usable plugin and three upcoming capabilities. No bright promotion, no chips. Total catalog height about400.
concepts.strength: 当前能用的插件最明确，待接入项更安静。
concepts.tradeoff: 按状态分组，不是完全平铺。

concepts.title: 紧凑卡片
concepts.direction: COMPOSITION C: restrained two-column compact actionable tiles, fundamentally denser than the supplied giant info cards. Search field width280 top right y76. Grid begins y136 with2 columns, gap16, each tile552px wide and112px tall, two rows. Each tile is WHITE subtle1px border#e8ebf0 radius12px, padding16. Icon36px at upper-left, name16px to right on same row with a little gap. Subtitle14 below name (not below icon) one line only. At far right align a compact 使用 action on available tile or noninteractive small plain 待接入 text on others. No footer region, no separate tall CTA row, no repeated description, no empty interior areas. Four tiles exactly 官网知识/短剧制作 then 网站与应用/文旅影像. Available tile has subtle pale blue1px border, all others neutral. Total content grid240px tall. All content aligned like a well-crafted app launcher, not large marketing cards.
concepts.strength: 保留图标辨识，卡片高度大幅收紧。
